description: Searches for recent news on a topic — articles, market-moving posts and exchange notices, newest first. Exchange notices (kind 'exchange', title prefixed [Exchange kind]) come from Binance, Bybit, OKX and Upbit's own listing and delisting feeds; for the full schedule with exact times use catalysts_exchange_listings. Each item is tagged with its kind and, where measured, the price move that followed the headline.
name: news_search

items.description: Newest first; empty when nothing matched

coins.description: Coin tickers the item names; may be empty

date.description: Publication time as the feed states it, ISO 8601; absent when undated

impact.description: Measured price move after the headline; absent when not measured

downPct.description: Lowest excursion in the window, percent

pct.description: Net move over the window, percent

upPct.description: Highest excursion in the window, percent

timeMs.description: date as epoch ms; absent when undated or unparseable

title: Crypto News Search
